solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

parts.note: a shot is a go or try, which is also a turn
a coat is a covering, as a coat of paint

explanation.surface: Someone takes a shot at a rat and then hides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rat' looks like the rodent but is the verb or noun for someone who betrays their side.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat in the sense of a deserter or betrayer is a person who switches allegiance.

parts.note: the ten is one of the honour cards in bridge
the ace is another honour card in bridge

explanation.surface: A bridge holding with two top cards.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the honours are the ace, king, queen, jack and ten.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge and whist, this term names a holding of the cards above and below an opponent's high card.

clue.text: Box office after smash action film

indicators.note: after puts the box-office letters following the smash piece

parts.note: to ram is to smash into

explanation.surface: An action movie is a box-office smash.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stallone movie about a Vietnam veteran is a famous example of a violent action movie.

definitions.meaning: Peter Pan is a stage play for youngsters
something very simple is said to be a doddle

explanation.surface: Barrie's fairy tale is a simple matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A thing requiring no effort is trivially simple, and J. M. Barrie's work is a drama for youngsters.

definitions.meaning: what is in a teapot is the brew

explanation.surface: A pot or whatever it holds.
explanation.definitionFit: Old slang names cannabis by this drink, which is also what fills a brewing pot.

parts.note: an orc is a sea-monster in old legend (also a killer whale)
hid means concealed

explanation.surface: A sea-monster hides a dazzling blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a gaffe, but here it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: This exotic flowering plant is known for showy blooms, so it is a striking bloomer.

definitions.meaning: to have ... someone is to have phoned them
a spoke can be a ladder's crosspiece or a chair's crossbar

explanation.surface: Made a call and talked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoke' looks like the past of speak but is a noun, a crossbar.
explanation.definitionFit: A past participle of the calling verb, and a crossbar on a ladder or chair.

clue.text: Museum — foremost of such surrounded by historical treasures

indicators.note: surrounded by means the first letter sits inside the treasures word

parts.note: a nation's heritage is its historical treasures

indicators.note: foremost of means the first letter of the word that such points back to

parts.note: such refers back to the word museum at the start of the clue

explanation.surface: A museum whose finest pieces are surrounded by national treasures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'such' stands for 'Museum', so 'foremost of such' gives M.
explanation.definitionFit: The great art gallery in St Petersburg is one of the world's best-known museums.

clue.text: Something got from Internet reduced charge

parts.note: down means lowered or reduced
a load is a charge or burden

explanation.surface: An internet purchase came with a lower fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A file pulled off the web onto one's computer is the noun for this transfer.

clue.text: Reverse for computer company beset by clouds

indicators.note: Reverse at the head of the clue tells us to read the whole computer-company-beset group backwards

parts.note: IBM is the large American computer company
beset, meaning surrounded, gives IN, as something besieged is in among its attackers

explanation.surface: A tech firm's U-turn while under a cloud of trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reverse' turns round IBMIN, the computer company plus IN (from 'beset').
explanation.definitionFit: Nimbus clouds are rain clouds, and this is the Latin plural form of nimbus.

clue.text: They serve up stock of wine in cases having triumphed

indicators.note: in puts the wine stock into the cases-plus-triumphed string, between its two parts

parts.note: crew is a past tense of crow, to exult or triumph
a bin is a rack or store where wine is kept

explanation.surface: Waiters bring up wine from the cellar in cases after a victory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' means up in the air, not bringing something upstairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Flight attendants serve passengers while the aircraft is airborne, hence serving up high.

clue.text: Where people manage to fool fish endlessly then tie boat up

parts.note: to con is to fool

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the fishing word is cut off

parts.note: to troll is to fish by trailing a line

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the mooring word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to moor is to tie up a boat

explanation.surface: Instructions for fooling fish and then mooring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts TROLL to TROL; 'up' turns MOOR into ROOM. 'manage to' looks like part of the instructions; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The operations hub where staff run a system or event is where managing happens.

clue.text: Gets to talk to racing driver near pits

indicators.note: near places the driver beside the pits piece, the one following the other

parts.note: Jenson Button is a British Formula One driver
pits are holes in the ground

explanation.surface: A reporter grabs a word with an F1 driver by the pit lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pits' suggests the motor-racing pit lane but simply means holes.
explanation.definitionFit: To accost someone and detain them in conversation is the verb, from grabbing a coat lapel.

indicators.note: lively suggests energetic movement, so the letters of the following word are rearranged

explanation.surface: An interior designer matches the palette in a vibrant scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: To make colours go well together in dress or decor is a standard sense of the verb.

definitions.meaning: in the US a paper banknote is called a ...

explanation.surface: A dollar note bears the face of an ex-president.
explanation.definitionFit: A US paper note is a bill, and the familiar name of President Clinton is the same word.

clue.text: International body showing teeth sorting out knotty problem

parts.note: the UN is the United Nations
a dog snarling bares its teeth

explanation.surface: The United Nations bares its teeth to resolve a thorny issue.
explanation.definitionFit: Untangling a knot is disentangling, which fits sorting out something knotty.

clue.text: Being unconscious a lot abusing morphine, say

indicators.note: abusing means misusing or mistreating, so the letters of morphine and say are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A drug user's long blackouts blamed on morphine misuse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abusing' rearranges MORPHINE plus SAY; 'say' looks like the usual 'for example' but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical term names excessive sleepiness, so a person with it spends too much time asleep.

clue.text: One working with records spinning hits on air

indicators.note: spinning means turning round and round, so the letters are churned into a new order

explanation.surface: A DJ spins chart-toppers on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'records' and 'spinning' suggest a DJ; the records are historical documents.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar of the past studies archives and documents, the records of history.

indicators.note: regularly means taking letters at even intervals, here the first, third and fifth of the word

explanation.surface: The postman brings a letter on his regular round.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a letter of the Greek alphabet, the one between chi and omega.

clue.text: Saint gets end of lance in vital organ

indicators.note: gets in means the saint takes a letter inside
gets in means the saint takes a letter inside

parts.note: St Pancras was an early Christian martyr, also a London station

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word lance

explanation.surface: A saint is stabbed in a vital organ by a lance tip.
explanation.definitionFit: The gland behind the stomach that makes insulin is one of the body's essential organs.

indicators.note: behind places the director's letter after the other piece

parts.note: to pop off or pop out is to go

explanation.surface: A TV director works backstage on the talent show Pop Idol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop Idol' was a British TV singing contest; the clue splits it so that 'Idol' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is a worshipped image or deity, so a deity fits the word.

definitions.meaning: a tweak is a slight alteration
coppers are low-value coins, loose coinage

explanation.surface: Adjust the police force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police but means copper coins, the British pennies and twopences.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor alteration is a slight modification, and loose low-value coins are the same phrase.

indicators.note: in puts the single letter inside the sea word

parts.note: the briny is slang for the sea
A means one, as in a single thing

explanation.surface: A smart person is out at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone intelligent is said to have plenty of brains, an informal synonym.

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
one's lot is one's fate or fortune

explanation.surface: An idiot is trapped by fate.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal words for a stupid person, so they are synonyms.

parts.note: jolly is old naval slang for a Royal Marine
roger is radio talk for message received and agreed

explanation.surface: Buccaneers sign the usual maritime pact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standard' looks like a norm but is a flag.
explanation.definitionFit: The skull-and-crossbones flag flown by pirate ships is their banner or standard.

definitions.meaning: Ulysses S. ... was a US Civil War general
to accord is to give or allow

explanation.surface: A general agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accord' suggests agreement, but it is the verb meaning bestow.
explanation.definitionFit: The Union commander in the Civil War bore this surname, and to bestow something is a verb sense.

parts.note: a pea is a vegetable
R is an abbreviation for recipe, from Latin, as on prescriptions

explanation.surface: A recipe using fruit and veg.
explanation.definitionFit: The pear is a common orchard fruit, so this is an example of the category.

indicators.note: wrinkling means creasing up, so the letters of I simpered are crumpled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone smiles coyly and their face creases.
explanation.definitionFit: The outer layer of the skin is its medical name, so skin is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Space-travelling captain not starting to annoy

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the captain's name is dropped

parts.note: Captain Kirk commands the starship Enterprise in Star Trek

explanation.surface: A starship captain refuses to start, to his crew's annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: To vex or irritate someone is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Arab tax inspectors previously on a Stephen Fry programme

indicators.note: on places the tax letters ahead of the rest in a down-reading sense of attachment

parts.note: IR is the Inland Revenue, the former name of the UK tax authority
QI is a BBC quiz show hosted by Stephen Fry

explanation.surface: A tax man from the Gulf appears on a Stephen Fry show.
explanation.walkthrough: The Inland Revenue was Britain's tax office until 2005; QI is a long-running British TV panel show.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Iraq is an Arab, so the nationality is an example of the broader term.

parts.note: despatched means sent off

explanation.surface: A railway guard is sent off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guard' looks like the railway guard on a train but is a soldier keeping watch.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier posted to keep watch is a lookout or guard.

indicators.note: not English means the letter E, the abbreviation for English, is dropped

parts.note: Keira Knightley is a British actress

explanation.surface: A titled actress who is not English.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving like a chivalrous knight means being noble and gallant.
